import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
names=["круассан","маффин","печенье"]
half_empty=pd.Series({name:T.loc[:,np.flatnonzero(product==name)].sum(axis=1).ge(2).pipe(lambda s:s[s].index[0]) for name in names})
a=T.loc[(T.index>="11:00")&(T.index<="12:45")]
observed_by_product=pd.Series({name:float(a.loc[:,np.flatnonzero(product==name)].to_numpy().sum()*.25) for name in names})
observed_empty_hours=float(observed_by_product.sum())
inv=np.load("showcase_inventory.npz")
print("inventory keys",inv.files)
initial,demand,refill=inv["initial"],inv["demand"],inv["refill"]
times=np.array(pd.date_range("2000-01-01 07:00",periods=len(demand),freq="15min").strftime("%H:%M"))
def simulate(events):
    stock=initial.copy();out=[]
    for t,d in zip(times,demand):
        if str(t) in events:
            batch=refill[events[str(t)]]
            stock=stock+batch*(stock==0)
        stock=np.maximum(0,stock-d)
        out.append(stock==0)
    out=np.array(out)
    return [float(out[(times>=lo)&(times<hi)].sum()*.25) for lo,hi in [("11:00","13:00"),("13:00","17:00"),("07:00","22:00")]]
schedule_scenarios=pd.DataFrame([simulate({"13:00":0,"17:00":1}),simulate({"11:00":0,"17:00":1}),simulate({"11:00":0,"13:00":0,"17:00":1})],index=["исходный","перенос","добавочная"],columns=["morning","afternoon","whole_day"])
print(half_empty,observed_empty_hours,observed_by_product,schedule_scenarios)
